title: Webb County District Clerk Urges Residents to Return Juror Notice Forms
excerpt: Residents who receive an official juror notice should fill it out and send it back, the Webb County district clerk said — the office is not getting enough of the forms returned, and the information decides who is eligible to serve on a jury.
content:
Residents who receive an official juror notice should fill it out and send it back, the Webb County district clerk said, according to KGNS.

The form matters because the information on it helps determine who is eligible to serve on a jury. The clerk said the office has not been getting enough of the forms returned.

The district clerk is Esther Degollado, who was re-elected to the office Nov. 3.

Prospective juror lists in Webb County are drawn from valid Texas driver’s licenses, Texas identification cards and voter registration lists, according to the county. The Central Jury Room is on the second floor of the Webb County Justice Center, 1110 Victoria St., across from the District Clerk’s Office in Suite 203.

Residents who submit the juror questionnaire online have 60 minutes to complete the session before it times out, the county says. Questions about jury duty can go to the chief deputy at (956) 523-4244 or to the clerks at (956) 523-4241, (956) 523-4243 or (956) 523-4449. The District Clerk’s Office is open Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

Sources: KGNS — “Webb County district clerk urges residents to return juror notice forms”, Nov. 25, 2026; Webb County — Jury Duty, https://www.webbcountytx.gov/774/Jury-Duty
